$comment: Anchor S3 prefix vectors, one verdict per validator. `terraform` is the modules/anchor-prefix variable validation (tests/prefix.tftest.hcl runs every entry whose verdict is not n/a); `zod` is AUDIT_ANCHOR_DESTINATION_S3_PREFIX in auditAnchorPublisherEnvSchema. `value: null` is the variable unset, which Terraform never sees (the root variable has a default). Non-empty values must agree; the empty prefix is valid for a non-Terraform deployment writing at the bucket root, and refused by Terraform because the bucket policy needs a prefix.
